points.text: No quantitative comparison with prompt-aware pruning baselines like GlimpsePrune.
Efficiency claims based on single model/setting with little breakdown of savings.
Only the 90% pruning ratio evaluated; scaling with pruning level unknown.
Method heuristic, lacking a formal objective.
No robustness or failure analysis when relevance and diversity misbalanced.
Evaluation limited to ~7B VLMs; larger models untested.
Adding diversity to task relevance is incremental novelty.
Figure 1 does not explain why diversity helps.
Recent token pruning methods (VisionZip, Dynamic-LLaVA, etc.) not discussed or compared.
Average pooling of prompt embeddings includes task-irrelevant tokens.
Diversity selection may pick useless background tokens; motivation doubtful.
No comparison with methods balancing relevance and diversity.
Needs validation on more models and parameter scales.
Reimplemented baselines lack aligned tuning; comparison possibly unfair.
Method overly simple; no theoretical or complexity analysis.
Framework figure too generic.
Memory savings tiny and latency worse than DivPrune; claims overstated.
Efficiency setup unstated; one model; no TTFT, throughput or edge results.
No default for k, undermining plug-and-play and zero-shot claims.
Mean-pooled prompt relevance is weak; template boilerplate and alternatives unaddressed.
No limitations or failure analysis despite large drops on OCR and POPE.
POPE reported only as F1.
Multi-image and video settings untested.
Abstract's SOTA and minimal-loss claims stronger than results.
Only one baseline compared.
Setup details missing: pruning location, k definition, prompt tokens, resolutions, backbone.
Small MMMU differences over-interpreted.
ChartQA gain explained as noise reduction without test.
Qwen2.5-VL cross-attention description may be wrong.
Reproducibility statement does not match appendix content.
Code only promised upon acceptance.
Error bars dismissed because inference deterministic.
Typos and Figure 3 duplicating Table 2.
k chosen per benchmark on reported splits; unequal versus DivPrune.
Benchmark-tuned k makes 'zero-shot' label strained.
No variance or significance tests for tiny gains.
MMMU k-sweep ordering likely noise but interpreted.
Too few baselines; FastV, PAR, GlimpsePrune not run.
Self-built relevance baseline receives no tuning.
Efficiency on one model and benchmark; hardware and FLOPs/TTFT missing.
Memory savings ~1.5% and slower than DivPrune, yet called substantial.
Only a single 90% keep rate; no accuracy-budget curve.
Ablations limited; no similarity, location or k=0 controls.
Reproducibility statement claims undocumented modifications.
MMMU split and sample counts unclear.
LLaVA-NeXT GQA drop contradicts 'consistent' claim.
Typos and k notation inconsistency.
k selected on official test splits, producing headline numbers.
'Must be prompt-aware' conclusion untested; controls absent.
'Matches SOTA with minimal loss' contradicted by large drops.
Only one competitor.
No significance tests; determinism justification wrong.
MAE wrongly presented as theoretical basis for compression.
FastV mis-described.
'Predominantly prompt-agnostic' framing contradicts own related work.
ChartQA gain may be harness artifact; unpruned scores near chance.
Memory reduction overstated; latency worse; one model.
DivPrune described inconsistently.
'MMVU' typo and unsupported Appendix A claim.
LLaVA-NeXT backbone unspecified.
Video inputs suggested but not evaluated.
Incremental over DivPrune: relevance seed before same diversity step.
Prompt-agnostic framing of prior work overstates gap.
FastV described inaccurately.
Missing text-guided baselines (SparseVLM, VisionZip, CDPruner).
MAE is not a theoretical basis.
Cosine relevance between mean text embedding and projector output untested.
'Must be prompt-aware' not supported by Table 2.
Qwen2.5-VL architecture description likely inaccurate.
Pruning insertion point per model unstated.

P.summary: Missing comparisons with prompt-aware and recent pruning methods.
No failure analysis of balance misconfiguration.

Q.summary: Mean-pooled cosine relevance assumption weak and untested.
